text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ikuno Dictus and Twin Turbo initiated 
"Operation Teio Comeback at the All 
Comers."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Putting on a fierce, full-power battle in 
the All Comers to reignite the despondent 
Tokai Teio's spirit. Her friends fully 
agreed with that plan.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro McQueen decided to help train Twin 
Turbo. Her reason for helping was that she 
resonated with Ikuno Dictus's feelings.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
For every Umamusume to continue running as 
long as they desire. The Trainer wished to 
help Ikuno Dictus achieve that future.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ikuno Dictus completes her flawless 
preparations for the All Comers. The fated 
showdown is just around the corner.
